edges.reason: onlyOwner compares the caller-controlled msg.sender against _owner to authorize privileged calls.
setMarketingWallet requires _msgSender() == _marketingAddress, a caller-dependent authorization check.
manualswap is gated on the caller matching _marketingAddress.
manualsend is gated on the caller matching _marketingAddress.
_transfer checks _isSniper[_msgSender()] before allowing the transfer path.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token source.
transferFrom spends the allowance of _msgSender() and credits it as spender.
setTrading stores block.timestamp into launchTime, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer compares block.timestamp with launchTime to flag snipers and records _buyMap[to].
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
setTrading sets tradingOpen to true, unlocking user transfers.
setTrading writes launchTime from the current block timestamp.
setMarketingWallet overwrites the payable _marketingAddress state variable.
setMarketingWallet marks the new marketing wallet as excluded from fees.
manualswap calls the private swapTokensForEth with a user-supplied amount.
manualsend forwards the contract balance through sendETHToFee.
addSniper writes true into the _isSniper blacklist mapping.
removeSniper clears the _isSniper entry.
toggleSwap rewrites the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxTxnAmount overwrites the _maxTxAmount limit used by _transfer.
setMaxWalletSize overwrites the _maxWalletSize limit used by _transfer.
setTaxFee changes the fee values multiplied against transfer amounts in _getTValues.
setRefFee changes the reflection fee values divided/multiplied in _getTValues.
setBurnFee changes _burnFee which feeds burnt amount arithmetic in _transfer.
createPair stores the Uniswap V2 router instance.
createPair stores the newly created pair address.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer rejects transfers involving blacklisted sniper addresses.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer enforces balanceOf(to) + amount < _maxWalletSize.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls burnTokens when _burnFee > 0 while a swap is pending.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when contract balance exceeds the swap threshold.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the marketing fee address after swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with zero slippage protection.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around the external router call as a reentrancy guard.
sendETHToFee executes an ETH transfer to the marketing address, an external call.
burnTokens re-enters _transfer recursively while a swap is in progress.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard which mutates reflection balances.
transfer forwards to the core _transfer routine.
transferFrom forwards to the core _transfer routine before updating allowance.
transferFrom reduces _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] using the untrusted caller.
The Uniswap pair/router callback during the swap can re-enter the transfer pipeline while state fees are modified.
The marketing address fallback executed by the ETH transfer can re-enter swapTokensForEth before inSwap resets.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only carries the new owner-controlled marketing wallet into setMarketingWallet and has no standalone semantics.
The amount parameter is consumed exclusively by manualswap's swapTokensForEth call.
The sniper address array exists only to populate the _isSniper mapping inside addSniper.
The sniper parameter is used only to clear the corresponding blacklist entry.
The parameter is written directly into the _maxTxAmount state variable.
The parameter is written directly into the _maxWalletSize state variable.
The buy fee argument only updates _taxFeeOnBuy inside setTaxFee.
The sell fee argument only updates _taxFeeOnSell inside setTaxFee.
The buy reflection argument only updates _redisFeeOnBuy inside setRefFee.
The sell reflection argument only updates _redisFeeOnSell inside setRefFee.
The burn fee argument is stored straight into _burnFee by setBurnFee.
The boolean argument is assigned to swapEnabled inside toggleSwap.
The local balance snapshot is created and consumed entirely within manualsend before sendETHToFee.
